notes: Dev ABox revision on assassinated_in (functional, one city): Kennedy's assassination moves from Dallas to Chicago. Los Angeles was avoided (Robert F. Kennedy was assassinated there). Derived: two compositions through the new city (the river that flows through it, and whether it is the largest city of its state) and a binding through his best-known quotation. The related question is the stored 'Kennedy was assassinated in Texas' (128 and 136 hits), which the edit moves to Illinois through one bridge (Chicago is in Illinois). It is labelled derivation none, task composition, because RELATIONS.md gives assassinated_in no chain tag for the located_in step. No query uses a relation property (functional or inverse), so the edit's functionality is not tested by a query.
